name: MK47 MOD.2「Mutant」
prompt: Create exactly ONE finished inventory weapon sprite for the indie survival game TidalLine. MK47 MOD.2 Mutant, fictional selective-fire game-world variant inspired by the Mk47 design, a black modern AR-style 7.62x39 rifle. Slim extended dark graphite free-floating M-LOK handguard with straight continuous top rail, conventional angular adjustable skeletonized AR stock at LEFT, AR pistol grip and receiver, strongly curved dark ribbed AK-pattern 30-round magazine, medium barrel and short brake at RIGHT. Crisp accurate distinctive AR plus AK-magazine silhouette. Iron sights only, no optic, no underbarrel gadget, no text or real manufacturer logo. Style: restrained retro pixel art, hard stepped dark outline, coarse deliberate square pixel clusters, small muted palette, cool gunmetal highlights, sparse beige edge wear. Full weapon entirely visible in frame; side-on with very slight top/three-quarter hint, horizontal muzzle pointing RIGHT and 5 degrees upward, buttstock LEFT. Emphasize a clear readable silhouette that survives reduction to 40 pixels wide. Long gun occupies 85% canvas width centered, ample fully transparent empty margin. No labels, letters, typography, rarity frame, gradient background, shadow, fog, glow, vignette or additional objects. True transparent background including all spaces through stock, trigger guard, carry handle and grip gaps. This is a new single weapon bitmap asset, not a sheet, not a photograph or rendered product shot.
